explanation: The theorem is `Psp4EvenSimple`, a statement from the classification of finite simple groups. It concerns a Sylow 2-subgroup situation in PSp4 over a field of characteristic 2, with odd-prime-order automorphism actions, and it concludes that n is even and an automorphism group is cyclic. The proof relies entirely on the library's own definitions and lemmas (`Lin2.Five.projEquiv`, `normalizes_of_mulEquiv_odd`, `autCyclic_of_forall`, `even_of_pow_centralizes` and similar). Mathlib has none of this machinery. I did not run searches, because Mathlib has no classification-of-finite-simple-groups or Sp4 normalizer/Sylow content, so I judge it very unlikely that any Mathlib declaration states this result.
